name: Backup n8n Workflows to Google Drive

parameters.content:
## n8n workflow backup -> Google Drive

**One-time setup**

1. *Get All Workflows* needs an **n8n API** credential.
   Create the key in n8n under Settings -> n8n API, then point the
   credential's base URL at this instance (e.g. `https://n8n.example.com/api/v1`).
2. Both Google Drive nodes need a **Google Drive OAuth2** credential.
3. Open **Backup Settings** and replace `YOUR_GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID`
   with the ID of the Drive folder that should hold the backups.
   It is the last path segment of the folder URL:
   `https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/<THIS_PART>`
4. If that folder lives on a **Shared Drive**, change the `Drive`
   field on *both* Drive nodes from `My Drive` to that shared drive.

**What it does**

Every run creates a dated subfolder (`n8n-backup-YYYY-MM-DD`) and drops one
`.json` file per workflow into it - active and inactive alike. Each file is
the raw workflow definition, so it can be re-imported straight into n8n.

*Backup Summary* ends the run with the folder link and a file count. If any
upload fails the others still complete, and *Fail On Upload Errors* then
marks the execution failed and names the workflows that did not make it.

Hit *Run Backup Now* to test, or leave the daily schedule to do it at 03:00.
